---
title: "Wine Quality Neural Network"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(caret)
library(neuralnet)

wine <- read_xlsx("data/winequality.xlsx")
names(wine) <- c(
  "color","fixedAcidity","volatileAcidity","citricAcid","residualSugar",
  "chlorides","freeSulfurDioxide","totalSulfurDioxide","density","pH",
  "sulphates","alcohol","quality"
)
wine <- wine[complete.cases(wine), ]
wine$color <- factor(wine$color)
```

## Dummy encoding
```{r}
dummies <- dummyVars(quality ~ ., data=wine, fullRank=TRUE)
x <- as.data.frame(predict(dummies, newdata=wine))
y <- data.frame(quality=wine$quality)
```

## Train/test split
```{r}
set.seed(1234)
idx <- createDataPartition(y$quality, p=0.70, list=FALSE)
x_train <- x[idx, , drop=FALSE]
x_test  <- x[-idx, , drop=FALSE]
y_train <- y[idx, , drop=FALSE]
y_test  <- y[-idx, , drop=FALSE]
```

## Scale using training data only
```{r}
x_pp <- preProcess(x_train, method="range")
x_train_s <- predict(x_pp, x_train)
x_test_s  <- predict(x_pp, x_test)

y_pp <- preProcess(y_train, method="range")
y_train_s <- predict(y_pp, y_train)
```

## Train neural network
```{r}
train_nn <- cbind(x_train_s, quality=y_train_s$quality)
formula_nn <- as.formula(
  paste("quality ~", paste(names(x_train_s), collapse=" + "))
)

set.seed(1234)
wine.model <- neuralnet(
  formula_nn,
  data=train_nn,
  hidden=10,
  linear.output=TRUE,
  lifesign="minimal"
)
```

## Held-out prediction
```{r}
pred_scaled <- compute(wine.model, x_test_s)$net.result[,1]

quality_min <- y_pp$ranges[1, "quality"]
quality_max <- y_pp$ranges[2, "quality"]
pred <- (quality_max - quality_min) * pred_scaled + quality_min

actual <- y_test$quality
mse <- mean((actual - pred)^2)
rmse <- sqrt(mse)
mae <- mean(abs(actual - pred))
correlation <- cor(actual, pred)

data.frame(MSE=mse, RMSE=rmse, MAE=mae, Correlation=correlation)
```

## Interpretation
Performance should be judged on the held-out test observations. Correlation describes association between predicted and actual values but should not replace error metrics such as RMSE or MAE.
